name: Leisure and aristocratic education
plain_explanation: Young wealthy Athenians in Plato's circle had no need to work and spent their time on mathematics, science, and philosophy, and could judge poetry recitation like connoisseurs.
precise_definition: The condition of the leisured Athenian upper class before the Peloponnesian War, which Russell says allowed the pursuit of the newly discovered art of deductive reasoning across the whole field of knowledge.
